title: Convert the close door from test run to proof check
action: Extract the proof check into a NEW shared helper verbs/cells/proof.rs (registered in cells/mod.rs) implementing the plan's door contract: given the feature's capped cells (including archive), a cap whose trace.report.tests is present but empty/malformed refuses, naming the cell and the remedy (re-cap with a real proof line); a cap with NO report record is legacy — passes with a named note. In close.rs, retire the test door: run_declared_tests, its deferral branch (defers to bee worktree merge when a worktree is granted) and the CLOSE_TESTS_* detail constants stop executing commands.test; call the proof helper instead (per D7). Close does NOT read trace.report today — it reads capped cells only for scribing debt (close.rs ~406-431, list_cells_including_archive(root, feature, "capped")); add the report read there. Do not touch CI, verbs/test_runner.rs, or .bee/logs/test-results.json (per D4); after this change bee test is that log's only writer — the D2 red-base claim door in handlers_write.rs (~716-767) keeps reading it unchanged; confirm its refusal remedy names `bee test` as the refresh path (edit the remedy text if it does not) and pin that with one test. Fix the stale auto-run comment at handlers_close.rs:191 ("the boundary now: bee close runs commands.test…"). Update the close help row in generated/registry_payload.json (it still says close runs the FULL declared commands.test). Repoint drivers/tests.rs assertions that pin the old run/deferral behavior; cover the triad: all-proofed feature closes; present-but-empty proof refuses naming the cell; legacy report-less cap passes with the note; refusal is red output, never silent.
